about.title: About L-LEX
about.body: L-LEX is a free, unofficial search engine for Iraqi and Kurdistan Region legislation — built to make legal articles findable in seconds, in Kurdish Sorani, Arabic, and English, with no accounts and no tracking.
about.method: Kurdish Sorani is the source-of-truth language of both statutes. English and Arabic translations are machine-generated with a fixed legal glossary and are always labeled with a visible per-article status until human review.
about.creator: Created and maintained by Las Khoshnaw.
